sn42.8:1.1: Ekaṃ samayam Bhagavā Nālandāyaṃ viharati Pāvārikambavane || || 2
sn42.8:1.2: Atha kho Asibandhakaputto gāmaṇi Nigaṇṭhasāvako yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || pe || 3 Ekam antaṃ nisinnaṃ kho Asibandhakaputtam gāmaṇim Bhagavā etad avoca || ||
sn42.8:1.3: Kathaṃ nu kho gāmaṇi Nigaṇṭho Nātaputto sāvakānaṃ dhammaṃ desetī ti || || 4
sn42.8:1.4: Evam kho bhante Nigaṇṭho Nāṭaputto sāvakānaṃ dhammaṃ deseti || ||
sn42.8:1.5: Yo koci pāṇam atimāpeti sabbo so āpāyiko nerayiko || yo koci adinnam ādiyati sabbo so āpāyiko nerayiko || yo koci kāmesu micchācarati sabbo so āpāyiko nerayiko || yo koci musā bhaṇati sabbo so āpāyiko nerayiko ||
sn42.8:1.6: yam bahulaṃ yam bahulaṃ viharati tena tena niyyatī ti || ||
sn42.8:1.7: Evaṃ kho bhante Nigaṇṭho Nāṭaputto sāvakānaṃ dhammaṃ desetī ti || || Yam bahulaṃ
sn42.8:1.8: yam bahulaṃ ca gāmaṇi viharati tena tena niyyatī ti || || Evam sante na koci āpāyiko nerayiko bhavissati || yathā Nigaṇṭhassa Nāṭaputtassa vacanaṃ || || 5
sn42.8:2.2: yo so puriso pāṇātipātī rattiyā vā divasassa vā samayā samayam upādāya katamo bahutaro samayo yaṃ vā so pāṇam atimāpeti yaṃ vā so pāṇaṃ nātimāpetī ti || ||
sn42.8:2.3: Yo so bhante puriso pāṇātipātī rattiyā vā divasassa vā samayā samayam upādāya appataro so samayo yaṃ so pāṇam atimāpeti || atha kho so va bahutaro samayo yaṃ so pāṇaṃ nātimāpetī ti || || Yam bahulaṃ
sn42.8:2.4: yam bahulaṃ ca gāmaṇi viharati tena tena niyyatī ti || || Evaṃ sante na koci āpāyiko nerayiko bhavissati || yathā Nigaṇṭhassa Nāṭaputtassa vacanaṃ || || 6
sn42.8:3.2: yo so puriso adinnādāyī rattiyā vā divasassa vā samayā samayam upādāya katamo bahutaro samayo yaṃ vā so adinnam ādiyati yaṃ vā so adinnaṃ nādiyatī ti || ||
sn42.8:3.3: Yo so bhante pa puriso adinnādāyī rattiyā vā divasassa vā samayā samayam upādāya appataro so samayo yaṃ so adinnam ādiyati || atha kho so va bahutaro samayo yaṃ so adinnaṃ nādiyatī ti || Yam bahulaṃ
sn42.8:3.4: yam bahulaṃ ca gāmaṇi viharati tena tena niyyatī ti || || Evam sante na koci āpāyiko nerayiko bhavissati || yathā Nigaṇṭhassa Nāṭaputtassa vacanaṃ || || 7
sn42.8:4.1: Taṃ kiṃ maññasi gāmaṇi || yo so puriso kāmesu micchācārī rattiyā vā divasassa vā samayā samayam upādāya katamo bahutaro samayo yaṃ vā so kāmesu micchā carati yaṃ vā so kāmesu micchā na caratīti || ||
sn42.8:4.2: Yo so bhante puriso kāmesu micchācarī rattiyā vā divasassa vā samayā samayaṃ upādāya appataro so samayo yaṃ so kāmesu micchā carati || atha kho so va bahutaro samayo yaṃ so kāmesu micchā na caratīti || ||
sn42.8:4.3: Yam bahulaṃ yam bahulañca gāmaṇi viharati tena tena niyyatī ti || || Evaṃ sante na koci āpāyiko nerayiko bhavissati || yathā Nigaṇṭhassa Nātāputtassa vacanaṃ || || 8
sn42.8:5.1: Taṃ kim maññasi gāmaṇi || yo so puriso musāvādī rattiyā va divasassa vā samayā samayam upādāya katamo bahutaro samayo || yaṃ vā so musā bhaṇati yaṃ vā so musā na bhaṇatī ti || ||
sn42.8:5.2: Yo so bhante puriso musāvādi rattiyā vā divasassa vā samayā samayam upādāya appataro so samayo yaṃ so musā bhaṇati || atha kho so va bahutaro samayo yaṃ so musā na bhanatī ti || ||
sn42.8:5.3: Yam bahulaṃ yam bahulañ ca gāmaṇi viharati tena tena niyyatī ti || || Evaṃ sante na koci āpāyiko nerayiko bhavissati || yathā Nigaṇṭhassa Nāṭaputtassa vacanaṃ || || 9
sn42.8:6.1: Idha gāmaṇi ekacco satthā evaṃvādī hoti evaṃdiṭṭhi || ||
sn42.8:6.2: Yo koci paṇam atimāpeti sabbo so āpāyiko nerayiko || yo koci adinnam ādiyati sabbo so āpāyiko nerayiko || yo koci kāmesu micchā carati sabbo so āpāyiko nerayiko || yo koci musā bhāṇati sabbo so āpāyiko nerayiko ti ||
sn42.8:6.3: tasmiṃ kho pana gāmaṇi satthari sāvako abhippasanno hoti || || 10
sn42.8:6.6: Yo koci paṇam atimāpeti sabbo so āpāyiko nerayiko ti ||
sn42.8:6.7: atthi kho pana mayā pāṇo atimāpito Aham pamhi āpāyiko nerayiko ti diṭṭhiṃ paṭilabhati ||
sn42.8:6.8: taṃ gāmaṇi vacam appahāya taṃ cittam appahāya taṃ diṭṭhim appaṭinissajjitvā yathā hataṃ nikkhitto evam niraye || ||
sn42.8:6.10: Yo koci adinnam ādiyati sabbo so āpāyiko nerayiko ti || ||
sn42.8:6.11: atthi kho pana mayā adinnam ādinnam aham pamhi āpāyiko nerayiko ti diṭṭhiṃ paṭilabhati ||
sn42.8:6.12: taṃ gāmaṇi vācam appahāya taṃ cittam appahāya taṃ diṭṭhim appaṭinissajjitvā yathā hatam nikkhitto evaṃ niraye || ||
sn42.8:6.14: Yo koci kāmesu micchā carati sabbo so āpāyiko nerayikoti ||
sn42.8:6.15: atthi kho pana mayā kāmesu micchā ciṇṇam
sn42.8:6.16: aham pamhi āpāyiko nerayiko ti diṭṭhim patilabhati ||
sn42.8:6.17: taṃ gāmaṇi vācam appahāya taṃ cittam appahāya taṃ diṭṭhim appaṭinissajjitvā yathā hataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ niraye || ||
sn42.8:6.19: Yo koci musā bhaṇati sabbo so āpāyiko nerayikoti ||
sn42.8:6.20: atthi kho pana mayā musā bhaṇitam
sn42.8:6.21: aham pamhi āpāyiko nerayiko ti || diṭṭhim paṭilabhati ||
sn42.8:6.22: tam gāmaṇi vācam appahāya taṃ cittam appahāya taṃ diṭṭhim appaṭinissajjitvā yathā hatam nikkhitto evaṃ niraye || || 11
sn42.8:7.1: Idha pana gāmaṇi tathāgato loke uppajjati arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā ||
sn42.8:7.2: so anekapariyāyena pāṇātipātaṃ garahati vigarahati Pāṇātipātā viramathā ti āha ||
sn42.8:7.3: adinnādānaṃ garahati vigarahati Adinnādānā viramathā ti cāha ||
sn42.8:7.4: kāmesu micchācāraṃ garahati vigarahati Kāmesu micchācarā viramathā ti cāha ||
sn42.8:7.5: musāvādaṃ garahati vigarahati Musāvādā viramathā ti cāha ||
sn42.8:7.6: tasmiṃ kho pana gāmaṇi satthari sāvako abhippasanno hoti ||
sn42.8:7.8: Bhagavā kho anekapariyāyena pāṇātipātaṃ garahati vigarahati Pāṇātipātā viramathāti cāha || ||
sn42.8:7.9: Atthi kho pana mayā pāṇo atimāpito
sn42.8:7.10: yāvatako vā tāvatako vā || taṃ na suṭṭhu taṃ na sādhu ||
sn42.8:7.11: ahaṃ ceva kho pana tappaccayā vippaṭisārī assaṃ ||
sn42.8:7.12: na me taṃ pāpakammam akatam bhavissatīti ||
sn42.8:7.13: so iti paṭisaṅkhāya taṃ ceva pāṇātipātām pajahati ||
sn42.8:7.16: evam etassa pāpassa kammassa samatikkamo hoti || || 13
sn42.8:8.1: Bhagavā kho anekapariyāyena adinnādānaṃ garahati vigarahati Adinnādānā viramathāti cāha || ||
sn42.8:8.2: Atthi kho pana mayā adinnam adinnaṃ yāvatakam vā tāvatakaṃ vā ||
sn42.8:8.3: yaṃ kho pana mayā adinnam ādinnam yāvatakaṃ vā tāvatakaṃ vā taṃ na suṭṭhu taṃ na sādhu ||
sn42.8:8.4: ahaṃ ceva kho pana tappaccayā vippaṭisārī assaṃ na me tam pāpakammam akatam bhavissatīti ||
sn42.8:8.5: so iti paṭisaṅkhāya tañceva adinnādānam pajahati ||
sn42.8:8.7: evam etassa pāpassa kammassa pahānaṃ hoti ||
sn42.8:8.8: evam etassa pāpassa kammassa samatikkamo hoti || || 14
sn42.8:9.1: Bhagavā kho pana anekapariyāyena kāmesu micchācāram garahati vigarahati Kāmesu micchācārā viramathā ti cāha || ||
sn42.8:9.2: Atthi kho pana mayā kāmesu micchāciṇṇaṃ yāvatakaṃ vā tāvatakaṃ vā ||
sn42.8:9.3: yaṃ kho pana mayā kāmesu micchāciṇṇaṃ yāvatakaṃ vā tāvatakaṃ vā taṃ na suṭṭhu taṃ na sādhu
sn42.8:9.4: ahañ ceva kho pana tappaccayā vippaṭisārī assaṃ na me tam pāpakammam akatam bhavissatīti ||
sn42.8:9.5: so iti paṭisaṅkāya taṃ ceva kāmesu micchācāram pajahati || āyatiṃ ca kāmesu micchācārā pātivirato hoti || ||
sn42.8:9.6: evam etassa pāpassa kammassa pahānaṃ hoti ||
sn42.8:9.7: evam etassa pāpassa kammassa samatikkamo hoti || || 15
sn42.8:10.1: Bhagavā kho pana anekapariyāyena musāvādaṃ garahati vigarahati Musāvādā viramathā ti cāha || ||
sn42.8:10.2: Atthi kho pana mayā musābhaṇitam yāvatakam vā tāvatakaṃ vā ||
sn42.8:10.3: yaṃ kho pana mayā musābhaṇitaṃ yāvatakaṃ vā tāvatakaṃ vā taṃ na suṭṭhu na sādhu || ahañceva kho pana tappaccayā vippatisārī assaṃ na me tam pāpakammam akatam bhavissatī ti || ||
sn42.8:10.4: So iti paṭisaṅkhāya taṃ ceva musāvādam pajahati āyatiṃ ca musāvādā paṭivirato hoti ||
sn42.8:10.5: evam etassa pāpassa kammassa samatikkamo hoti || || 16
sn42.8:11.1: So pāṇātipātam pahāya pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti ||
sn42.8:11.3: kāmesu micchācāram pahāya kāmesu micchācārā paṭivirato hoti ||
sn42.8:11.5: pisuṇaṃ vācam pahāya pisuṇāya vācāya paṭivirato hoti ||
sn42.8:11.6: pharusaṃ vācam pahāya pharusāya vācāya paṭivirato hoti || ||
sn42.8:12.1: Sa kho so gāmaṇi ariyasāvako evam vigatābhijjho vigatavyāpādo asammuḷho sampajāno patissato mettāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disam pharitvā viharati || tathā dutiyaṃ || tathā tatiyaṃ || tathā catuttham iti uddham adho tiriyam sabbadhi sabbattatāya sabbāvantam lokam mettāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamaṇena averena avyāpajjhena pharitvā viharati || || 17
sn42.8:12.2: Seyyathāpi gāmaṇi balavā saṅkhadhamo appakasireṇeva catuddisā viññāpeyya ||
sn42.8:12.3: evam eva kho gāmaṇi evam bhāvitāya mettāya cetovimuttiyā evam bahulīkatāya yam pamāṇakatam kammaṃ na taṃ tatrāvasissati na taṃ tatrāvatiṭṭhati ||
sn42.8:13.1: sa kho so gāmaṇi ariyasāvako evaṃ vigatābhijjho vigatavyāpādo asammūḷho sampajāno patissato karuṇāsahagatena cetasā || mudita ||
sn42.8:13.3: upekkhāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharati || tathā dutiyaṃ || tathā tatiyaṃ || tatha catuttham iti uddham adho tiriyaṃ sabbādhi sabbattatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokam upekkhāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena avyāpajjhena pharitvā viharati || || 18
sn42.8:13.4: Seyyathāpi gāmaṇi baḷavā saṅkhadhamo appakasireneva catuddisā viññāpeyya ||
sn42.8:13.5: evam eva kho gāmaṇi evam bhavitāya upekkhāya cetovimuttiyā evam bahulikatāya yam pamāṇakataṃ kammaṃ na taṃ tatrāvasissati na taṃ tatrāvatiṭṭhatī ti || || 19
sn42.8:14.1: Evaṃ vutte Asibandhakaputto gāmani Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
